top_clips.title: Kurtz calls it "break or breach." The 30-day patch window is gone.
Kurtz: attackers steal your session token — the "trust this computer" pass — and they're in your inbox for 30 days.
CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz: AI agents collapsed the cyber "pyramid of pain." Now "anyone can look like a nation state." My take: this is the strongest bull...
Chamath Palihapitiya: AI will produce 9-10 megacorps that each go "from the application layer all the way down to the dirt." His example: Palo Alto Networks...
Kurtz: OpenAI "took the airbags off the agents." Defenders didn't have frontier models, so they used Chinese models to see what happened.
